SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_media_type_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(track_count) AS average_media_type_track_count
FROM (
  SELECT MediaTypeId,
         AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
) AS media_type_averages;
